headline: Fractal Reports First $100 Million Quarter as Net Income Surges
summary: Fractal posted its first $100 million quarter in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, with net income jumping 139%.
why: Strong revenue milestones and surging net income demonstrate rapid scaling and improved profitability for high-growth technology and analytics firms.
